description: Adds official APK download instructions: visit https://moondownload.com/ and find the regional paid-users section. Choose mrp_ru_arm64.apk (tested) or mrp_ru_universal.apk (untested).

patches.name: Remove regional and expiration restrictions
patches.description: Allow any device locale and remove the fixed expiration cutoff in the regional Moon+ Reader Pro build. Stops if the expected checks are missing or ambiguous. Download the original regional APK from https://moondownload.com/ (mrp_ru_arm64.apk or mrp_ru_universal.apk), then select I already have an APK in Manager.

release_notes:
Adds the official APK source to the README and the patch, app, and version descriptions.

Visit https://moondownload.com/ and find the **For Russian & Belarusian paid users who can't get the app from GooglePlay** section. Choose **mrp_ru_arm64.apk** (ARM64; tested variant), or **mrp_ru_universal.apk** (universal; untested here). Save the APK and select **No, I already have an APK** in Morphe Manager.

The current patch API cannot override Manager's centrally resolved download button. The official-page instructions avoid that lookup for this regional build.

All five tests pass. This bundle successfully patches the original regional 10.8 ARM64 APK using Morphe Desktop with fingerprint validation. The patch logic is unchanged. Device launch is not tested.
repoDescription: Independent Moon+ Reader regional-build patches compatible with Morphe Manager
